name: ex-v1
idea_origin: Exploración line, 29 Oct: replica calibrated on the 2,743 real DeepSeek story decisions (choice model, scripts/exploracion/); quality judge on cp-v12
operator: cp-v12 rules and turn loop + quarterly changes backed by the calibrated replica + rewrite for the quality rubric
hypothesis: Same story behaviour as cp-v12 (story steps unchanged in substance) with better quarters: Prepare report materials with every free Energy point at the starting level; report, network, report and a key project at levels 2-3; from level 4 Skill learning plus Prepare report materials and Apply for rotation; Health recovery from Health 5 (not 4); plus a hard Health brake in stories at Health 3 or below. Calibrated replica (4,000 games per arm): +1.3 from the quarters alone, +1.8 with the Health brake (Health deaths 6.5 % -> 1.1 %). Quality: phased 48-month plan, near-limit table, observations marked as ours (Claude judges: Opus 84/83, Sonnet 72/71 against 73/72 and 66/66 for cp-v12).
predicted_behaviour: Pairing as cp-v12 (turn loop text unchanged); quarters at the starting level all to reports; no Health death; game scores like the family with fewer sinks by Health.
refutation: Pairing below 90 % in sondas (the loop section changed one note field), or choices on the L1 bank beyond v4 repeat noise, or Health deaths in games.
change: cp-v12 -> ex-v1: status line without 'Reviews here' (stalled start read from Months at current level); quarterly lines renumbered (removed the review-talk line, which never fired in our games, C57); line 2: Health recovery first from Health 5, the main action changes only at Health or Dignity 4; starting-level quarter to reports; levels 2-3 quarter in v4 order; level 4+ Skill learning + Prepare report materials + rotation; story step 3 adds a Health 3 brake; 48-month table, review calendar, step 2 in bullets and near-limit table rewritten as observations.
notes: Evidence: lab/reports/exploracion/README.md (replica calibrated on the real DeepSeek decisions, quarter search, Sonnet bank, quality judges). The Skill states observations from our runs as ours, with no thresholds, titles or fixed answers; margins on the published 0-10 ranges are marked as ours. Test plan: lab/reports/exploracion/plan-deepseek.md.
